notes.title: Last Eclipse Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
Last Eclipse Update 1.1.3

- Fixed the infinite combo that could be performed with any character with any of the special powers.

- Shortened the stun time on hits and special moves.

- Cleaned up poorly exported sprites.

- Added motion blur to moves.

- Some low blows weren't executing for all 8 characters.

- Changed the AI ​​difficulty in Arcade and VS modes.

- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Update 1.1.2

- Fixed Minester and Spring's projectiles from damaging very little.
- Changed all characters' self-doubles, which now consume 100 gauge to prevent infinite combos.
- Some Autumn and Minester hits weren't damaging hitboxes.
- Fixed all fighters' falling animations after a strong hit.
- Winter's special power had little gravity.
- Fixed several bugs.

notes.content:

notes.title: Last Eclipse Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Last Eclipse Update 1.1.0

- Reduced game size from 19GB to 1.1GB.
- Reduced loading time to 5 seconds.
- Fixed hitboxes.
- Fixed the dialog menu from looping infinitely.
- Improved overall gameplay and polished damage hitboxes.
- Finally 100% compatible with Steam Deck.
- PROTON HOTFIX optimal gaming resolution: 1280x720 60Hz.

notes.title: Last Eclipse Update 1.0
notes.content:
Finally out of Early Access

Version 1.0!!

- The game has been completely balanced
- Video options have been added, allowing you to change the game resolution
- The game starts faster
- Dialogues can now be skipped with a button
- Improved performance in the game engine
- Various adjustments to the stages
- Added missing animation frames
- Thanks to all the people who supported us during these two years of Early Access. We were unable to add two more characters. We are a small company, but more fighters could be added in the future if you continue supporting us.

Animas Games Dev Team
